title: Stock market next week (Aug 17-21): Walmart, Home Depot, Target earnings; FOMC minutes; Reddit joins S&P 500
summary: The week of Aug 17-21 brings a triple retail earnings test — Walmart (Aug 20), Home Depot (Aug 18), Target (Aug 19) — plus the FOMC July 28-29 meeting minutes release (Aug 19) and Reddit's debut as an S&P 500 constituent.
why: 大盘级别事件集中本周：三大零售商财报将检验美国消费韧性；FOMC纪要揭示7月28-29日会议的讨论细节（当次会议按兵不动，3票异议倾向加息）；Reddit入选标普500影响指数基金被动买入。3天前发布，本周事件仍在发酵中。

title: 2 big catalysts ahead: Nvidia Q2 earnings Aug 26 (consensus ~$91.8B revenue) and Jackson Hole Aug 27-29
summary: CNBC identifies two defining market events in coming weeks: Nvidia's Q2 earnings on Aug 26 (Street consensus revenue ~$91.8B, ~+96% YoY), and the Jackson Hole Economic Symposium Aug 27-29 where Fed Chair Warsh delivers his first keynote as chair on Aug 28. Theme: 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy.'
why: 英伟达Q2财报是AI投资周期的晴雨表，共识预期收入918亿美元(YoY+96%)；Warsh首次在Jackson Hole发表讲话，其'货币哑铃'策略（短端灵活+激进QT）立场将影响市场对利率路径的定价。两者叠加是未来2周最大宏观+个股双重催化剂。发布于昨日(8/16)。

title: China's July factory output, retail sales growth miss forecasts
summary: China's July economic data disappointed: retail sales +3.7% YoY (est. +4.6%), industrial output +5.7% YoY (est. ~+6%), fixed-asset investment +1.6% YTD YoY (est. +2.7%), urban unemployment 5.2%. All major indicators came in below consensus.
why: 中国7月经济数据全线低于预期，零售销售增速从6月的4.5%回落至3.7%，工业产出和固投同样走弱，触发市场对进一步刺激政策的预期，直接影响港股（腾讯、美团等）及A股情绪。数据于2026-08-15公布，仍在影响本周市场走向。已追溯到Reuters白名单原文；但具体数字未与国家统计局原文直接核对，故标 verified=false。
